title: Trump hits Macron with tariff threats, underscores tense US-France relations

contentText: Donald Trump posted a private message from France’s leader and threatened hefty tariffs on French wine and champagne, targeting an ally who has taken a firm stance against US pressure over Greenland. “Macron is learning the hard way that there is no friendship with Donald Trump,” FRANCE 24 International Affairs commentator Douglas Herbert said, adding: “The flattering and cajoling only work as long as all you do is flatter and cajole Donald Trump.”
